sources.title: Qwen-Image-2512 in ComfyUI: Photorealistic Text to Image
sources.snippet: Generate images at seven aspect ratios in ComfyUI with the December Qwen-Image update, tuned for human realism, natural detail, and accurate text layout. Qwen-Image-2512 is the December update of Qwen-Image’s text-to-image foundational model.
